Agent Name: Planner
Step Number: 11
Reason for Mistake: In Step 11, the Planner incorrectly concluded that the death date was "12 August 1896" based on the Tate Britain search results which only showed the years "1829–1896" and did not specify a day. The Planner then explicitly instructed the WebSurfer to format the date as "1896-08-12" in the subsequent step, introducing an error (12th instead of 13th) that contradicted the verified date of August 13 found in other sources like Britannica and Wikipedia. This was a hallucination/error in data extraction and interpretation by the Planner.
